name: NiceShots: Mockup Frame Editor
dev: Chengdu Xiaomeng Huanian Technology Co., Ltd.

ios.desc:
When you want to add a background to the most satisfying photo, when you want to beautify your screenshots, when you want to show how your website or app looks on the device mockups... Then you can try NiceaShots. It offers pixel-level design perfection, ensuring that your photos or screenshots fit perfectly into the device.

NiceShots has received a major update! This time, NiceShots supports adding phone models to videos, customizing video size ratios, and offers a variety of exquisite video background configurations. Easily create a perfect video.

Embrace the ease of designing with Shots. Create beautiful mockups in seconds, giving you more time to focus.

Any Mockup that you need.
Choose a mockup that suits your needs add your screenshot, design or any image to get started.
Pre-made Layouts.
Transform how your mockup looks from our many custom tailored layouts.
Beautiful Device Mockup Backgrounds.
Variety of hand-picked background packs including gradients, images & more.
Export for anywhere:
Various proportions. Export pixel perfect images with pre-made frames based on the social media of your choice.

You are very welcome to use NiceShots to make beautiful screenshots,NiceShots can easily and happily achieve shell screenshots, shell screenshots, screenshot beautification. It is a powerful model editor. We are also continuously enriching various phone mockups (iPhone 15, iPhone14, other phone) and other device mockups (iPad, iMac, iWatch, MacBook).
Simplicity and efficiency have always been what NiceShots stands for, and I hope you can get your work done with a minimum of manipulation, just a few easy clicks, and create beautiful images that will make you look great when you share them! I added a very nice 3D phone mockups and now NiceShots can make amazing 3D phone mockups!

There are many size models, many proportions, many backgrounds and many style combinations to make your pictures stand out and make your work shine on forums or social platforms!
Support common picture proportions, almost cover any kind of scene.
Rich background color types, you can complete their own personalized Settings. You can use the background blur effect or adjust the level of background blur. In addition, when you want to customize the background color, you can choose any color on the color palette.
You can use any image in your album as a background!
Of course, you can also set a transparent background, but remember to use png format export. Yes, we support image expor
